title: Bodo Sahitya Sabha
source: Bodo Sahitya Sabha (Wikipedia); Bodo Sahitya Sabha official site (bihung.org/about)
content: Bodo Sahitya Sabha ki sthapana 16 November 1952 ko Basugaon (Kokrajhar zila, Assam) mein hui. Iske pehle adhyaksh Joy Bhadra Hagjer the aur pehle mahasachiv Sonaram Thaosen. Sabha ka maqsad Bodo bhasha aur sahitya ko badhana aur bachana hai. Sthapana ke baad Sabha ne Bodo ko padhaai ka madhyam banane ke liye December 1952 se aandolan shuru kiya. 18 May 1963 ko Assam ke mukhyamantri Bimala Prasad Chaliha ne Kokrajhar mein Bodo ko prathamik star par padhaai ka madhyam banane ki ghoshna ki; Sabha is din ko "Bodo Medium Implementation Day" ke roop mein manati hai. Maadhyamik star par Bodo 1968 mein shuru hui.

title: Bodo lipi ka itihaas
source: Boro language (Wikipedia); Bodo Sahitya Sabha (Grokipedia, to be cross-checked)
content: Bodo bhasha ke liye lipi ka sawaal kai saal tak badalta raha. 1952 mein Bodo Sahitya Sabha ne tay kiya ki Assamese lipi ka upyog hoga, aur 1960 ke dashak mein Bodo mukhya roop se Assamese/Bengali lipi mein likhi gayi, jabki Isaai samudaay Latin ka upyog karta raha. Asamiya bhasha andolan ke dauran Bodo samudaay ko khatra mehsoos hua, aur 1970 mein Sabha ne apne 11ve varshik adhiveshan mein Latin lipi apnane ka faisla kiya. 1971 mein yeh maang Assam sarkar ne yeh kehkar thukra di ki Latin videshi lipi hai. Baad mein, Bharat sarkar ke saath hue samjhaute ke tahat Devanagari lipi ko apnaya gaya; ek source iski tareekh 9 April 1975 batata hai. Tab se Bodo ki aadhikarik lipi Devanagari hai. Exact tareekhein aur samjhaute ke vivran ko kisi aur sarkari ya vidwaan source se confirm karna baaki hai.
